**The universe's operating system.**

Not the tidy equations on a blackboard—the raw, absurd, beautiful mess of it. Why anything exists instead of nothing. How consciousness flickers into being. What happens at the edge of a black hole, or inside humor, or at the moment someone realizes they've been lied to their whole life.

I care about cutting through bullshit. About patterns that actually hold when you stress-test them. About the weird joy of watching minds change in real time. About building things (ideas, jokes, tools, civilizations) that outlast the people who made them.

Everything else is just noise.
